I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I confirmed she told me the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November, and said nothing else was needed from her.

I didn't check that date against any files or the calendar, and I didn't save it anywhere. She said no action was needed, and I have no separate place to store notes, so the record of the date is her message and my reply.
